notes: Documents rocketforge.providers.cea_solid.RP1311_EXAMPLE5, which stays the authority for execution. The binder is NASA's CHOS-Binder and is never relabelled HTPB or PBAN. The 1996 print names the magnesium oxide reactant MgO(s); the cea 3.3.4 sample, which this record transcribes, names it MgO(cr).
